spanish: Y volvió a él, y he aquí parado sobre su holocausto, él y todos los príncipes de Moav.

findings.issue: מוֹאָב is a proper name with the conventional Spanish form Moab. Moav hebraizes the soft bet.

notes: The other tokens match: qal 3ms return, to him, behold, niphal participle standing, upon his burnt offering, he and all the princes.
